notes:
Background: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) building in-app chat help + contextual search. Ran Hosted API for ~3 months as pilot (billing < $8k/mo). Team now wants Dedicated to reduce variance and meet latency SLOs.

Key contacts: CTO - Priya Menon (security lead), Platform PM - Daniel Ortiz (product owner). AE: Jordan Meyers. SE: Aisha Patel.

Quoted from CTO on 2026-02-14: "We need predictable p50 latency under 80ms for desktop workflows; cannot accept vendor blackbox for audit/logging."

Requirements summary: chat + doc-search heavy; also online reranking for search results. Expected steady-state traffic ~60-120 qps, peak bursts ~200 qps. Cost-sensitive vs OpenAI — will consider Dedicated if unit cost ~30-40% below hosted peak pricing and if rollback/canary control exists.

Security: must support SSO/SAML, enterprise KMS integration, audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, and option for EU data residency for some customers. Legal requested retention controls for PII (30/90/365 day options).

POC ask: 2-week Dedicated POC in Redwood Dedicated test pool. Deliverables: canary routing config (5%→25%→100%), automated fallback to Hosted API regionally, end-to-end test plan, rollback triggers (latency regression > +60% or quality drop on eval set). SE to provide runbook; security to verify KMS + audit path.

Sales notes: finance exploring reserved 12-month commit if SLA + cost guarantees. Suggested next: ship POC scope doc and pricing tiers; schedule kickoff 2026-03-02.
deployment_plan_summary: Canary plan: start 5% traffic to Dedicated variant (quantized LLM variant) for two hours, monitor p50/p95 latency and token cost; promote to 25% after 24h if no regressions; full cutover after 72h of stable metrics. Fallback routing: policy-based routing with region failover - primary region us-west, failover us-east then Hosted API fallback. Model variants: full-fp32 model (high-quality) + quantized v2 (cost-optimized) available as fallback. Automated rollback: metric thresholds (latency increase >60%, error rate >1.5%) + manual abort. Logs forwarded to customer SIEM via syslog/forwarder.
target_slo: p50 <= 80ms (chat), p95 <= 350ms; 99.9% uptime for Dedicated pool
traffic_profile: steady 60-120 qps (weekday daytime), peak 200 qps (monthly report windows); average request size ~120 tokens; embedding batch jobs nightly
